descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you independent and self-driven? Do you have sharp analytic skills? We’re looking for someone like that who can:
–work closely with Credit Officers, and perform risk assessment and continuous monitoring of assigned portfolio
–evaluate counterparty credit risk based on good understanding of the counterparty's risk profile, business environment, exposure, and financial performance as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of counterparties’ credit worthiness (This may include client due diligence via client visit or conference call)
• – prepare counterparty reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• – monitor counterparty and portfolio credit quality, as well as key risk drivers of portfolio credit exposure on a continual basis
• – day-to-day monitoring of credit exposure against approved limits and parameters
• – perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and portfolio deep dive when necessary.
